sections.lecture_material: Resolved LES fluctuations, ensemble means, stresses and resolved/model energy postprocessing
sections.extension: General filter covariance partition retains mean-filter correction and filtered target; modeled equality is additional approximation

sections.lecture_material: Central schemes, numerical diffusion and MILES idea
sections.extension: Time stability/dispersion matters, no universal scheme rule or all-upwind SGS equivalence; MILES caption contradiction resolved contextually
sections.construction: Exact Euler-centered/upwind and Crank-Nicolson mode gains, modified-equation viscosity

sections.lecture_material: Domain/startup/resolution, eta comparison, wall units, wall-resolved and wall-modeled choices
sections.extension: No universal two-eddy, eta multiplier, first-yplus sufficiency or obligatory wall resolution for every drag/thermal prediction

sections.lecture_material: WM approximate Re and WR1.85point scaling versus DNS expense
sections.extension: Primary Reynolds definition, inlet scaling and nested-grid hypotheses retained; later revision bounded to abstract/introduction, no current hardware/performance guarantee
sections.construction: Wall point-density and delta^-2 integral exponents with alternative inlet families

sections.lecture_material: RANS/LES equation similarities, zonal/embedded versus unified approaches, URANS and interface challenge
sections.extension: Separate grids not universal taxonomy, changing viscosity alone insufficient, unsteady mean differs from filtered realization

sections.lecture_material: Synthetic RANS-to-LES fluctuations and LES-to-RANS energy feedback
sections.extension: One-point covariance not full divergence-free inflow or spectrum; scalar feedback factor not universal
sections.construction: Exact eight-sign covariance and conditional1.58333energy multiplier

sections.lecture_material: DESintended attached-RANS/separated-LES role, common mesh and illustrative economy
sections.extension: Actual length mechanism as bounded primary extension, not all-above-layer LES or fixed cost ratio; no DECIDER validation claim
sections.construction: Grid-dependent minimum and premature stress-depletion mechanism

sections.lecture_material: Undesired boundary-layer switching and delayed DES introduction/course close
sections.extension: Version-specific actual shielding functions and positive floor, no full SA/DDES solver or universal successful shielding
sections.construction: Limiting lengths, rd/fd values and required total-stress validation
